recommendation: Do not infer broad natural-language readiness from the old 12/12 benchmark. Prioritize SemanticKB intent/scope and metadata-driven entity/field/process selection, then subject/facet coverage. Retain these 20 as a failing regression set; later use a fresh held-out set to measure generalization. No export/rebuild is justified by this test alone.
workPerformed: Twenty scored read-only knowledge-tool calls, manual review and report/evidence writes only. No source-code, routing, source corpus, registry, CSV, graph, ERP, policy or service changes. Ordinary tool telemetry is allowed. No commit or push.
